subject: Refund approved but customer has not received funds
description: Customer says refund was approved 8 business days ago but funds are not visible.
resolution: Confirmed order refund status, explained 5 to 10 business day bank processing timeline, and asked customer to contact support again if funds were missing after the window.

subject: Refund missing after 15 business days
description: Refund was approved more than 10 business days ago and processor status was unavailable.
resolution: Escalated to Billing Operations with order ID, refund approval timestamp, and customer payment method.

subject: Unable to log in after password reset
description: Customer reset password but still receives session expired message.
resolution: Reviewed auth logs, identified AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED, and advised full sign-out, cache clear, and retry in incognito window.

subject: Tracking number has not updated
description: Customer says tracking has not moved for two days after fulfillment.
resolution: Explained that tracking can take up to 48 hours to update after carrier handoff and advised follow-up if no movement after that period.

subject: Cancel subscription and refund request
description: Customer wants to cancel subscription and asks for refund on current billing period.
resolution: Confirmed cancellation prevents future renewal and routed refund eligibility through refund policy review.

subject: Payment failed but customer sees pending bank charge
description: Customer payment failed but bank shows pending authorization.
resolution: Explained failed payments may leave temporary authorization holds and escalated when payment logs showed processor timeout.

subject: Account locked after MFA attempts
description: Customer is locked out after repeated MFA verification failures.
resolution: Escalated to Identity Engineering because repeated MFA failures required account security review.

subject: Package delayed with carrier exception
description: Carrier status reports exception and delivery is beyond expected date.
resolution: Escalated to Logistics with order ID, carrier status, tracking number, and customer address verification.

subject: Duplicate charge after subscription renewal
description: Customer sees two charges for one renewal period.
resolution: Escalated to Billing Operations with payment IDs and subscription ID because duplicate charges require transaction review.

subject: Cannot update card details
description: Customer receives an address verification error when updating payment method.
resolution: Asked customer to verify billing address and retry. Escalated when logs showed repeated AVS mismatch despite correct address.
